whatIs.title: What Are Local SEO Services and How Do They Work?
whatIs.p1: Local SEO is a targeted search engine optimization strategy that helps physical storefronts, service providers, and regional businesses dominate high-intent geographic searches. When prospective clients in your city look for immediate solutions, Local SEO connects you directly to ready-to-buy consumers.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Common questions about our Local SEO services and Google Maps rankings.
faq.q1: How long does it take to see results from Local SEO?
faq.a1: Typically, you can start seeing initial improvements in 4 to 8 weeks after NAP citation cleanup and GBP optimization, with peak ranking stabilization achieved within 3 to 6 months.
faq.q2: Do I need a physical address for Local SEO?
faq.a2: A physical address provides maximum ranking weight, but Service Area Businesses (SABs) like contractors, field consultants, and repair teams can also capture #1 3-Pack rankings by defining their service areas without displaying a street address publicly.
faq.q3: What is the Google Map Pack and why does it matter?
faq.a3: It is the three-listing block that appears above organic search results for queries with local intent. It captures over 50% of mobile search clicks and enables instant one-tap calling and directions.
faq.q4: How do domestic navigation apps impact local search in Iran?
faq.a4: Domestic apps like Neshan and Balad have widespread adoption for in-car and pedestrian navigation in Iran. Accurate business registration on these platforms alongside Google Maps is crucial for driving physical visits and direct phone inquiries.
faq.q5: How is Local SEO pricing structured?
faq.a5: Based on WebABC's official 2026 pricing benchmarks, initial local map setup ranges from $500 to $1,200, while ongoing local growth retainers range from $800 to $1,500/month (or 25–45 million Tomans in Iran). Retainers cover technical audits, Map Pack optimization, citation building, review acquisition, and transparent monthly call tracking.
